label: prf:quantum-characteristic-classes-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of quantum characteristic classes
html: Giraud's classification: the category of central \mathcal{B}-extensions of \mathfrak{G}_n is equivalent to H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}). Different local trivialisations of \mathfrak{G}_n yield Čech cocycles differing by 1-coboundaries, hence the same cohomology class. The class \kappa_n therefore depends only on the extension and the brane tower, not on the trivialisation.
